title: devtools package for build-time exporters and CLIs; one catalog exporter
description:
Repo plan phase 1.7. Build-time mains are scattered: documentation/SpliceArchitectureDoc, geometry/mesh/documentation ExportMeshNodeCatalog and ValidateDsl, platform/automation/documentation ExportAutomationRoutes (a near-identical 35-39 line main), data/PatchDecomposerCLI, the MeshSkeletonExtractor main. Move them to ixdar/devtools (named so it does not clash with the edit-tools package) and merge the two catalog export mains into one that writes both JSON files; update the pom exec entries (pom.xml ~136, 154, 168). ValidateDsl and BatchDslEvaluator build the parser by hand (new PythonParser(new PythonLexer(...))); switch them to NodeGraphRuntime.fromSource. mesh-node-catalog.json is generated into ixdar_automation_cli/ though no Python reads it: move its output beside automation_routes.json's documented consumers or to docs/, and update any agent docs that point at it.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. One export main produces mesh-node-catalog.json and automation_routes.json, byte-identical to master.
2. Behaviour is unchanged: the unit suite passes, every scene in CanvasSceneMap still launches, and the generated registries (MeshNodeRegistry, SceneRegistry, CommandRegistry, AutomationRouteRegistry) and automation_routes.json list the same ids as master. Moved packages carry their package-info.java, and ARCHITECTURE.md is regenerated by SpliceArchitectureDoc. No class is renamed.
3. The build runs the exporter as before (mvn compile regenerates both files).

4. Keeps the devtools command-line output, which is each tool's interface and not debugging: ExportAutomationRoutes' usage line ("Usage: ExportAutomationRoutes <routes-path> <catalog-path>") and its "Exported" line (the two old exporters printed the same), and PatchDecomposerCLI's skeleton sub-command, which prints the skeleton JSON ("System.out.println(skeletonJson);", the moved MeshSkeletonExtractor main's output) and lists itself in usage ("  skeleton <obj_path> [resolution]").
testing-plan:
1. Delete both JSON files, mvn compile, diff against master.
2. mvn test.
unknowns: Package name devtools; the user has not ruled yet.
changes-made: New package ixdar.devtools (package-info) holds SpliceArchitectureDoc, ExportAutomationRoutes, ValidateDsl and PatchDecomposerCLI, all keeping their names. ExportMeshNodeCatalog is merged into ExportAutomationRoutes, which takes <routes-path> <catalog-path> and writes both JSON files (one pom execution, export-automation-routes; export-mesh-node-catalog removed). mesh-node-catalog.json moves from ixdar_automation_cli/ to docs/ (no reader anywhere: Python CLI, tools, Daud, ai-workspace, skills). MeshSkeletonExtractor's main becomes the 'skeleton <obj> [resolution]' sub-command of PatchDecomposerCLI. ValidateDsl and BatchDslEvaluator build their graph with NodeGraphRuntime.fromSource (NodeGraphRuntime.functionDefs is now a public field) and reuse that runtime instead of building new ones. Emptied packages ixdar.documentation and ixdar.geometry.mesh.documentation deleted; ARCHITECTURE.md regenerated. Verified: both JSON files deleted then regenerated by mvn compile, byte-identical to eng-21 HEAD (diff to master is only sourceClass/sourcePath/generatedFrom/category fields from the stacked package moves); mvn test 521 run, 0 failures; registries list the same ids as eng-21; ValidateDsl output identical to master's class on test_function/coons_cube/curve_sweep_tube; quad-layout scene launches (tmp/eng-22.png).
